dct_creator_sm: Pasquale, Vanessa (Department of Animal Biosciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: This project aims to investigate how space allowance affects airflow and pig stress during transportation in a low deck mechanically ventilated vehicle under summer conditions by assessing the microclimate conditions inside the trailer, the post-transport pigs’ behaviour in lairage, their physiological conditions at slaughter, and lastly their carcass and meat quality.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Effects of space allowance on behaviour, physiology, skin lesions and meat quality of pigs transported in an actively ventilated vehicle in the summer and winter
